headline: The Linear Representation Hypothesis survives to 2025: the causal inner product stays more orthogonal than the Euclidean one on all 5 base models (2023-2025), with ~all binary single-token concepts still linear.

metrics.label: Causal orthogonality advantage (Euclid/causal ratio), 2025 models
metrics.note: Still >1 everywhere; ~1.5x for LLaMA lineage, weakens to ~1.25x for Qwen/OLMo (below paper's 1.5-2.5x band)

metrics.label: Causal off-diagonal mean (approx orthogonality), all concepts
metrics.note: Concepts stay approximately orthogonal under the causal metric across all generations

metrics.label: Concepts with linear subspace (Cohen's d>=1), newer models
metrics.note: Only Llama-2 has an exception (thing=>part, d=0.85), matching the paper; newer models fix it

metrics.label: C11 uncorrelatedness r, separable vs non-separable pair
metrics.note: Sanity check holds identically across the ladder

metrics.label: C8 intervention: king->queen flip (male=>female steering)
metrics.baseline: flips by alpha=0.2, king out top-5 by 0.3
metrics.note: Causal steering direction still works on every model

tables.title: Orthogonality & subspace across the model ladder (this session)

figures.caption: Did the finding survive? Top: mean off-diagonal |inner product| (0 = perfectly orthogonal) for the causal (solid) vs Euclidean (dashed) inner product across 5 base models 2023-2025, on the 22 concepts viable in all models; the causal line stays clearly below Euclidean everywhere (ratio annotated). The 2023 point matches the on-disk replication (0.046/0.069 causal/Euclid, all-27 concepts). Bottom: fraction of concepts with a linear subspace (Cohen's d>=1).
figures.alt: Two-panel figure. Top line chart: orange dashed Euclidean line above blue solid causal line across five models, causal ~0.052-0.062 and Euclidean ~0.067-0.087. Bottom bar chart: subspace fraction 21/22 for Llama-2 and 22/22 for the other four models.

notes: Every number computed this session from the 5 models' own unembedding matrices; the 2023/original side is read from the replication artifacts on disk and Llama-2 recomputed here reproduces 0.046/0.069 exactly.
22-concept intersection is used for the apples-to-apples series (5 morphological concepts lack >=10 single-token pairs under Llama-2's tokenizer); coverage disclosed per model in report.md.
The paper's quantitative '1.5-2.5x' band holds for the LLaMA lineage but not for Qwen/OLMo (~1.25x) - the effect persists but is weaker outside LLaMA.
Optional C6 measurement probe not run (GPU budget); optional C8 intervention was run and holds on all 5 models.
